labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for new behaviour (unit styling in ReprHighlighter) that Rich does not provide.

items.body:
This is a feature request, and per the [feature template](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/) new features need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened. Please start the idea there.

Rich does not currently style units after numbers. A related open report about the number regex is #3318. For now, a custom highlighter is the documented way to do this: see [docs/source/highlighting.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
